title.zh: 拨付1905比索56仙菲律宾货币，用于支付马尼拉市市政法院代理法官自1904年3月24日至6月30日期间薪金的法案
title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF ONE THOUSAND NINE HUNDRED AND FIVE PESOS AND FIFTY-SIX CENTAVOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE SALARY OF THE ACTING JUDGE OF THE MUNICIPAL COURT OF THE CITY OF MANILA FOR THE PERIOD FROM MARCH TWENTY-FOURTH TO JUNE THIRTIETH, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR.
title.orig: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF ONE THOUSAND NINE HUNDRED AND FIVE PESOS AND FIFTY-SIX CENTAVOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE SALARY OF THE ACTING JUDGE OF THE MUNICIPAL COURT OF THE CITY OF MANILA FOR THE PERIOD FROM MARCH TWENTY-FOURTH TO JUNE THIRTIETH, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR.
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp khoản tiền 1905 peso và 56 xu tiền Philippines để chi trả lương Thẩm phán tạm quyền của Tòa án Thị trấn Thành phố Manila cho giai đoạn từ ngày 24 tháng 3 đến ngày 30 tháng 6 năm 1904
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดสรรจำนวนเงิน1905เปโซและ56เซนตาวอสสกุลเงินฟิลิปปินส์เพื่อการจ่ายเงินเดือนผู้พิพากษาปฏิบัติหน้าที่ศาลเทศบาลนครมะนิลาสำหรับช่วงเวลาตั้งแต่วันที่24มีนาคมถึงวันที่30มิถุนายนพ.ศ.2447
title.id: Undang-Undang yang mengalokasikan jumlah 1905 peso dan 56 sentavo mata uang Filipina untuk pembayaran gaji Hakim Pelaksana Pengadilan Kota Manila untuk periode dari 24 Maret hingga 30 Juni 1904
title.ms: Akta yang mengeluarkan jumlah 1905 peso dan 56 sentavo mata wang Filipina bagi membayar gaji Hakim Bertindak Mahkamah Bandaraya Bandaraya Manila bagi tempoh dari 24 Mac hingga 30 Jun 1904

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated,
the sum of one thousand nine hundred and five pesos and fifty-six centavos. Philippine currency, for the
payment of the salary of the acting judge of the municipal court of the city of Manila, at the rate of seven
thousand pesos per annum, for the period from March twenty-fourth to June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 3, 1904.
